 "content": "from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The grid-line color is the less common dominant color among rows:
    # long horizontal grid lines contrast with the larger background regions.
    row_dominants = [Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] for row in grid]
    dominant_counts = Counter(row_dominants)
    line_color = min(dominant_counts, key=dominant_counts.get)

    # Horizontal/vertical lattice lines are the rows/columns largely made of
    # the line color; colored markers may replace a few lattice intersections.
    line_rows = [r for r in range(h) if sum(v == line_color for v in grid[r]) > w / 2]
    line_cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == line_color for r in range(h)) > h / 2]
    if len(line_rows) < 2 or len(line_cols) < 2:
        return []

    bg_color = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != line_color).most_common(1)[0][0]

    # Restrict to lattice columns that contain an actual colored marker.
    marked_cols = [c for c in line_cols if any(grid[r][c] != line_color for r in line_rows)]
    if len(marked_cols) < 2:
        return []
    c0, c1 = min(marked_cols), max(marked_cols)
    cols = [c for c in line_cols if c0 <= c <= c1]
    rows = line_rows

    out = []
    for ri in range(len(rows) - 1):
        row_out = []
        for ci in range(len(cols) - 1):
            corners = [grid[rows[ri]][cols[ci]], grid[rows[ri]][cols[ci + 1]],
                       grid[rows[ri + 1]][cols[ci]], grid[rows[ri + 1]][cols[ci + 1]]]
            if corners[0] != line_color and all(v == corners[0] for v in corners):
                row_out.append(corners[0])
            else:
                row_out.append(bg_color)
        out.append(row_out)
    return out


if __name__ == '__main__':
    demo = []
    markers = {
        (2, 5): 1, (2, 9): 1, (2, 13): 7, (2, 17): 7,
        (6, 5): 1, (6, 9): 1, (6, 13): 7, (6, 17): 7,
        (10, 5): 8, (10, 9): 8, (10, 13): 7, (10, 17): 7,
        (14, 5): 8, (14, 9): 8, (14, 13): 2, (14, 17): 2,
        (18, 5): 0, (18, 9): 0, (18, 13): 2, (18, 17): 2,
        (22, 5): 0, (22, 9): 0,
    }
    for r in range(23):
        row = []
        for c in range(26):
            v = 3 if r % 4 == 2 or c % 4 == 1 else 9
            row.append(markers.get((r, c), v))
        demo.append(row)
    expected = [[1, 9, 7], [9, 9, 7], [8, 9, 9], [9, 9, 2], [0, 9, 9]]
    assert transform(demo) == expected, transform(demo)
    test = [
        [5,0]+[5]*25+[0],
        [0,2]+[0]*25+[2],
        *([[5,0]+[5]*25+[0] for _ in range(6)]),
        [0,2]+[0]*25+[2],
        *([[5,0]+[5]*25+[0] for _ in range(3)]),
    ]
    print('demo verified:', transform(demo))
    print('test output:', transform(test))
    assert transform(test) == [[2]]
",
 "cross_profile": false
}

 "content": "from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Infer the lattice color as the least frequent row-dominant color.
    row_dominants = [Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] for row in grid]
    line_color = min(Counter(row_dominants), key=Counter(row_dominants).get)

    # Locate the horizontal and vertical lattice lines.
    line_rows = [r for r in range(h) if sum(v == line_color for v in grid[r]) > w / 2]
    line_cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == line_color for r in range(h)) > h / 2]
    if len(line_rows) < 2 or len(line_cols) < 2:
        return []

    bg_color = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != line_color).most_common(1)[0][0]
    marked_cols = [c for c in line_cols if any(grid[r][c] != line_color for r in line_rows)]
    if len(marked_cols) < 2:
        return []
    c0, c1 = min(marked_cols), max(marked_cols)
    cols = [c for c in line_cols if c0 <= c <= c1]

    # A cell is filled with its marker color when all four lattice corners
    # match; otherwise it receives the background color.
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(line_rows) - 1):
        row_out = []
        for ci in range(len(cols) - 1):
            corners = [grid[line_rows[ri]][cols[ci]], grid[line_rows[ri]][cols[ci + 1]],
                       grid[line_rows[ri + 1]][cols[ci]], grid[line_rows[ri + 1]][cols[ci + 1]]]
            if corners[0] != line_color and all(v == corners[0] for v in corners):
                row_out.append(corners[0])
            else:
                row_out.append(bg_color)
        out.append(row_out)
    return out
